role: Mesh reference scenes: builds a grid far from spawn at y 240..255 holding every registered block in every meta its class uses plus neighbor-dependent cells (fences, stairs, rails, wire, doors, beds, crops, torches, ladders, vines), then meshes each scene section through MeshProbe's path over the server world.
notes: Output sections.bin, chunks.bin, table.bin, tileentities.bin, atlas.json, manifest.json. Scene built on its own thread while the server is parked.
